# MediaPipe runtime assets

- Package: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 0.10.35
- Face model: MediaPipe Face Landmarker, float16, version 1
- Model source: `https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task`
- License information: https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_landmarker

The WASM files are copied deterministically from the installed npm package by `npm run assets:mediapipe`.
